name: Builder Decide (tests_passing) → Reviewer (qa mode)
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3. Fires when builder terminates with builder_decide(action=tests_passing) AND phasevalidator.QAModeGate has stamped chain.qa_mode_gate.proceed="true" on the builder loop entity AND evidence.summary_ready=true. The gate's load-bearing pre-check is tests_run > 0 AND tests_failed = 0 (ADR-041 §Risks mitigation qa-mode pre-check) — builder cannot deliver a qa-review-ready artifact without structurally-evidenced passing tests, so the reviewer LLM judges quality, not presence. Replaces dev-via-spec/07-builder-decide-to-qa-reviewer.json. needs_clarification from the builder is intentionally NOT a trigger here — that routes through 03-needs-clarification-to-researcher.json.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.reviewer-qa
on_enter.prompt:
Builder at loop $entity.instance terminated with builder_decide(action=tests_passing). Reason: $entity.triple.coordinator.decision_reason.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to inspect the builder's structured terminal (tests_run, tests_passed, tests_failed, artifact_summary).

Evidence summary (gate-rendered from architect's checks[]):

```
$entity.triple.evidence.summary
```

Iteration 2 — emit decide(action=accept|reject|needs_clarification, reason=<concrete>, blocking_question=<if needs_clarification>) per reviewer-qa/10-evaluation-contract.md three-rule grading. The qa-mode pre-check has already verified tests_run > 0 AND tests_failed = 0 — your job is to grade the BUILD QUALITY against the architect's checks, not re-verify presence.

metadata.proceed_sentinel: chain.qa_mode_gate.proceed on builder loop entity. Absence-of-sentinel blocks the rule fire fail-safe per ADR-041 §Risks mitigation qa-mode pre-check.
metadata.evidence_summary_plumbing: cmd/semteams/evidence/preprocessor.go subscribes to agent.complete.> and stamps evidence.summary + evidence.summary_ready at builder-loop completion. Triple-substitution `$entity.triple.evidence.summary` inlines the rendered output into the spawn prompt.
metadata.next_action_filter: tests_passing only. Under ADR-041's qa-mode pre-check design, tests_failing is structurally inadmissible for qa-grade — the gate fails closed and the chain stalls. Operators surface the stall via chain-paused/chain-failure operator views. The legacy 07 rule accepted both terminals; the new stance is stricter (builder cannot deliver a qa-review-ready artifact with failing tests). needs_clarification routes through 03-needs-clarification-to-researcher.json.
